mapper.insert: /* 결제시 payment테이블에 값 등록 */ insert into payment (payment_completed_no, cust_id, sell_products_no, rental_contract_no, pay_info_no, ent_ceo_no, ent_emp_id, manager_id, payment_type, contract_details, payment_details, payment_count, product_unit_price, total_price, payment_completed_date, payment_status, revision_date) values (#{paymentCompletedNo}, #{custId}, #{sellProdNo}, '일시불', 'pay_info_3', 'ent_ceo_1', 'entempid1', 'managerid1', #{paymentType}, '일시불', '일시불판매', #{paymentCount}, #{prodUnitPrice}, #{totalPrice}, CURDATE(), '정상결제상태', NOW())
mapper.select: select pd.products_nm, p.total_price, p.rental_contract_no, p.payment_completed_date from payment p inner join sell_products sp on p.sell_products_no = sp.sell_products_no inner join products pd on sp.products_no = pd.products_no where p.cust_id = #{custId} group by CASE WHEN p.rental_contract_no = '일시불판매' THEN CONCAT(p.rental_contract_no, '_', p.payment_completed_no) ELSE p.rental_contract_no END order by p.payment_completed_date desc
